text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. Brown tweed fitted double-breasted high-stand-collar jacket, integral same-fabric round-buckle waist belt, extra-wide faded olive-gray jeans, dark open-toe shoes barely visible.。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Edit this exact white background wardrobe product image. Remove the visible human toes under both trouser hems. Keep the same dark open-toe shoes but make them completely EMPTY with no feet, toes, skin or mannequin. Preserve every other garment, the brown tweed jacket, belt, olive-gray wide jeans, colors, texture, proportions and framing exactly. No new accessories.
